memory_update.text: MIDD is the primary US-listed reference anchor for restaurant commercial foodservice equipment, including equipment manufacture, distribution, and service.

WEST is an underfollowed small-cap candidate adjacent to the node through outsourced restaurant/foodservice beverage solutions, extracts, tea/coffee, and RTD capacity, but it is not a direct equipment-maintenance name.

DSGR is a speculative-shadow candidate for restaurant equipment uptime through MRO distribution and supply-chain services; direct restaurant and commercial-kitchen exposure is unproven and must be verified.

Farmer Brothers was one of the best direct beverage-equipment service fits, with technician install/maintenance/repair evidence, but should be excluded from the US-listed universe after the May 5, 2026 take-private closing unless a later listing status check contradicts this.

Several apparently pure foodservice equipment repair/parts distributors, including restaurant facilities maintenance and OEM replacement-parts networks, appear private or embedded inside larger distributors; later layers should search private comparables to identify public suppliers to those networks.

node: Restaurant equipment, beverage machines, service, and maintenance networks
summary: Expanded the restaurant equipment/service node into a two-lane universe. The strongest direct public-market anchor is Middleby, a commercial foodservice equipment manufacturer with restaurant and institutional kitchen exposure. The underfollowed lane is thinner because several highly relevant service networks and parts distributors are private or recently taken private; Farmer Brothers was a strong beverage-equipment service candidate but appears to have closed a take-private transaction in May 2026, so it is retained as a coverage-gap/comparable rather than a US-listed candidate. Public small/mid-cap candidates with plausible second-order exposure include Westrock Coffee as a beverage-solutions platform for restaurant/foodservice customers and Distribution Solutions Group as a speculative MRO/supply-chain-services proxy that still needs restaurant-customer proof.
